versions.changelog:
- Streamlined DFMEA focus for smart hardware industry with essential features.
- Now exports reports in JSON and Markdown formats (PDF, Excel, CSV removed).
- Provides basic mitigation strategies and simplified risk assessment (color coding removed).
- Reduces template and integration support to core smart hardware needs.
- Documentation and usage instructions updated for clarity and conciseness.

Initial release of DFMEA quality engineering tool with smart hardware industry support. Features include: standardized DFMEA templates, automatic RPN calculation, smart hardware specific risk analysis (IoT security, wireless connectivity, power management), CLI interface, and comprehensive reporting capabilities.
